sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: On Sunday, the president of Afghanistan fled the country.
sentences.zh: 周日，阿富汗总统逃离了该国。

sentences.en: The Taliban seized control of the country's capital, and the American-backed government there collapsed.
sentences.zh: 塔利班夺取了该国首都的控制权，美国支持的政府随之垮台。

sentences.en: In Kabul, chaos gripped the city as tens of thousands of people went into hiding or tried to escape.
sentences.zh: 在喀布尔，随着成千上万的人躲藏起来或试图逃离，城市陷入了一片混乱。

sentences.en: Among them is a 33-year-old woman, an outspoken critic of the Taliban, who asked that we refer to her by the initial R for fear of retaliation.
sentences.zh: 其中有一位33岁的女性，她是塔利班直言不讳的批评者，由于担心遭到报复，她要求我们以字母R来称呼她。

sentences.en: In the days leading up to the fall of Kamal, R packed her entire life into six suitcases and started searching for a way out.
sentences.zh: 在喀布尔陷落前的几天里，R将她的全部家当装进了六个手提箱，开始寻找出路。

sentences.en: Since Friday night, she's been sharing her experience and fears with my colleague, Lindsay Garrison, as the Taliban closed in.
sentences.zh: 自周五晚上以来，随着塔利班的逼近，她一直与我的同事琳赛·加里森分享她的经历和恐惧。

sentences.en: It's Monday, August 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月16日，星期一。

sentences.en: Hey, R.
sentences.zh: 嘿，R。

sentences.en: I know you are incredibly busy, but I was thinking that maybe you could record some voice memos and send them to me over the next few days.
sentences.zh: 我知道你非常忙，但我在想，也许你可以在接下来的几天里录一些语音备忘录发给我。

sentences.en: Anything that you're seeing, anything that you're thinking, if your situation changes, if you're able to get out of the country,
sentences.zh: 任何你看到的、想到的，如果你的情况有变，或者如果你能离开这个国家，

sentences.en: you can just record anything like that and send it to me.
sentences.zh: 你都可以录下来发给我。

sentences.en: And I hope you're doing okay, as okay as anyone can be in this kind of circumstance.
sentences.zh: 希望你一切都好，在这种情况下能保持安好。

sentences.en: Today, we just, a couple of hours ago, we learned that Logar collapsed, which is just 70 kilometers away from Kabul,
sentences.zh: 今天，就在几个小时前，我们得知卢格省沦陷了，那里距离喀布尔只有70公里，

sentences.en: which is so scary because now they are just very, very close to Kabul.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了，因为他们现在离喀布尔非常、非常近了。

sentences.en: And still there is no way for my family and I to leave.
sentences.zh: 而且我和我的家人仍然没有办法离开。

sentences.en: But with the help of some friends, we managed to find a safer place for tonight.
sentences.zh: 但在一些朋友的帮助下，我们设法为今晚找到了一个更安全的地方。

sentences.en: So I'm moving with my whole family there and we'll stay there tonight and we'll see what will happen because some people say that there might be fighting tonight.
sentences.zh: 所以我正带着全家人搬过去，我们今晚会待在那里，看看会发生什么，因为有人说今晚可能会有战斗。

sentences.en: They might start attacking Kabul tonight or tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 他们可能今晚或明天就会开始攻击喀布尔。

sentences.en: So I have been just moving houses.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在搬家。

sentences.en: I'm just like on the way, taking my suitcases, packing up, moving from one place to the other.
sentences.zh: 我就像是在路上，带着我的手提箱，打包，从一个地方搬到另一个地方。

sentences.en: And, yeah, it's just so overwhelming, so exhausting and scary.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，这真的让人不知所措，精疲力竭，而且很害怕。

sentences.en: I don't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: I really don't know what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: It's late Friday night here.
sentences.zh: 这里已经是周五深夜了。

sentences.en: And I think pretty early, your Saturday morning, I just wanted to see if anything ended up happening last night
sentences.zh: 我想你那边应该是周六清晨，我只是想看看昨晚有没有发生什么事，

sentences.en: and where you are.
sentences.zh: 以及你现在在哪里。

sentences.en: It's early morning and gladly nothing happened last night.
sentences.zh: 现在是清晨，很高兴昨晚什么事也没发生。

sentences.en: So my sister and I, we moved to this house and my mom and my brothers will join us today.
sentences.zh: 我和我姐姐搬到了这所房子，我妈妈和兄弟们今天会来和我们汇合。

sentences.en: So right now we are just trying to find a way that at least all of us can be together.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们只是在努力寻找一种至少能让我们所有人聚在一起的方法。

sentences.en: But we don't know.
sentences.zh: 但我们不知道。

sentences.en: We don't know what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: We are just very hopeful and trying to be optimistic.
sentences.zh: 我们只是怀抱希望，努力保持乐观。

sentences.en: And we just received messages that the Taliban are about to attack Kabul within 72 hours.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚收到消息说塔利班即将在72小时内攻击喀布尔。

sentences.en: And these, I don't know, they have been confirmed by official sources.
sentences.zh: 这些消息，我不知道，已经得到了官方来源的证实。

sentences.en: But I really don't know what is the plan for the Americans and for the British because they already brought some troops and they are bringing more troops today
sentences.zh: 但我真的不知道美国人和英国人的计划是什么，因为他们已经带了一些军队过来，今天还在增派军队，

sentences.en: to evacuate their staff and some Afghans.
sentences.zh: 以撤离他们的工作人员和一些阿富汗人。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I just don't have a good feeling today.
sentences.zh: 我今天感觉不太好。

sentences.en: I think we just don't have much time.
sentences.zh: 我想我们没多少时间了。

sentences.en: But I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm just praying that we will be out soon.
sentences.zh: 我只是祈祷我们能尽快离开。

sentences.en: I just walked to the main road and, you know, the roads are busy.
sentences.zh: 我刚才走到主路上，你知道，路上很繁忙。

sentences.en: People are walking around and they're doing their business.
sentences.zh: 人们走来走去，做着自己的事。

sentences.en: It looks like a normal day.
sentences.zh: 看起来像平常的一天。

sentences.en: But the thing is, I think maybe they have no clue that Kabul can fall any minute or any hour or any day.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，我想他们可能根本不知道喀布尔随时随地都可能陷落。

sentences.en: I was told that they might attack Kabul today.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉我他们今天可能会攻击喀布尔。

sentences.en: So it's better if I stay in this area so I don't get a stack somewhere.
sentences.zh: 所以我最好待在这个区域，这样我就不会被困在某个地方。

sentences.en: And also, I was told that the commercial flights might stop tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 而且，我还听说商业航班明天可能会停飞。

sentences.en: I don't know if it's true or false.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是真是假。

sentences.en: I'm waiting for the Canadians to tell me if I'm eligible, if they can put me on this liSt.
sentences.zh: 我正在等加拿大人告诉我我是否符合资格，他们是否能把我列入名单。

sentences.en: The Americans say that there's no guarantee, but they might be able to put us on the list and evacuate us, but they may not.
sentences.zh: 美国人说没有保证，但他们也许能把我们列入名单并撤离我们，但也可能不行。

sentences.en: So we are also, like, we are still trying to find, like, you know, ways out for myself and for my family members.
sentences.zh: 所以我们也在，你知道，还在为我和我的家人寻找出路。

sentences.en: Yeah, these are the latest updates that I have.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是我掌握的最新消息。

sentences.en: The Taliban are advancing relentlessly across Afghanistan as the U.S.
sentences.zh: 随着美国执行撤军的最后阶段，塔利班正在阿富汗各地无情地推进。

sentences.en: carries out the final stages of withdrawing all its troops.
sentences.zh: 随着国际部队基本撤离，这个伊斯兰组织正在从士气低落的阿富汗军队手中夺取更多领土。

sentences.en: With international forces largely gone, the Islamist group is taking more territory from a demoralized Afghan military.
sentences.zh: 塔利班在推特上发布了这段视频，显示其武装人员在装甲悍马车上庆祝，车子正穿过街道。

sentences.en: Taliban tweeted out this video of its fighters celebrating on top of an armored Humvee as it drove through the streets.
sentences.zh: 这些车辆是他们从受过美国训练和装备的阿富汗军队手中缴获的。

sentences.en: Vehicles they captured from U.S.-trained and equipped Afghan forces.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗总统阿什拉夫·加尼今天几天来首次公开露面。

sentences.en: Afghanistan's President Ashraf Ghani spoke publicly today for the first time in days.
sentences.zh: 他誓言要继续战斗。

sentences.en: He's vowing to keep fighting.
sentences.zh: 在今天上午对全国发表的讲话中，阿富汗总统阿什拉夫·加尼誓言不会放弃他所说的过去20年取得的成就。

sentences.en: A speech to his nation, Afghan President Ashraf Ghani, this morning, vowed not to give up over what he called the achievements over the past 20 years.
sentences.zh: 随着这一切的发生，成千上万的人继续涌入喀布尔。

sentences.en: And as this has been happening, tens of thousands of people continue to flood into Kabul.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人一无所有，因为他们来自战斗中心城市。

sentences.en: And many of them have come with nothing because they've come from cities that have been centers of fighting.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，喀布尔现在的气氛如何？

sentences.en: I'm just curious, what's the mood like in Kabul right now?
sentences.zh: 安静吗？

sentences.en: Is it quiet?
sentences.zh: 人们害怕吗？

sentences.en: Are people scared?
sentences.zh: 混乱吗？

sentences.en: Is it chaotic?
sentences.zh: 我只是好奇这座城市现在的真实感受。

sentences.en: I'm just curious what the city actually feels like right now.
sentences.zh: 我开车穿过城市，在人们的脸上看到了恐惧。

sentences.en: I'm driving through the city and I see fear in people's faces.
sentences.zh: 人们到处奔走，我看到数百人在银行后面排队，大概是为了取钱并关闭账户。

sentences.en: People are rushing everywhere and I saw hundreds of people lining up behind the banks to withdraw their monies and close their accounts probably.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我们刚刚听到了关于阿什拉夫·加尼总统即将辞职的消息。

sentences.en: And, yeah, and we just heard about this announcement that President Ashraf Ghani is going to resign.
sentences.zh: 尽管他在声明中没有提到，但看起来他很快就会辞职。

sentences.en: Even though he didn't mention it in his statement, but it seems that he will resign soon.
sentences.zh: 这就是我从消息来源听到的。

sentences.en: That is what I heard from my sources.
sentences.zh: 现在一切都变得更加复杂，更加不可预测。

sentences.en: Now everything is just even more complicated and even more unpredictable.
sentences.zh: 我不知道接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: I don't know what's going to happen anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 但这太可怕了，太令人担忧了。

sentences.en: But it's just terrifying and worrying.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 这太悲惨了，我一直带着手提箱从一个地方搬到另一个地方。

sentences.en: It's been so tragic that I have been just carrying my suitcases from one place to the other.
sentences.zh: 但我甚至不知道，我是否能带着它们逃出去。

sentences.en: But I was even knowing that, like, if I would ever get out with them.
sentences.zh: 但我只是带着它们从这里到那里，希望我能找到下一条出路。

sentences.en: But I'm just carrying them from here to there, hoping that I will find that next way.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.

sentences.zh: 我们正在从阿富汗获得新的进展，那里的局势每分钟都在变化。

sentences.en: We're getting new developments from Afghanistan, where the situation is changing there minute by minute.
sentences.zh: 今晚，阿富汗军队正试图在北部最大的城市马扎里沙里夫抵御塔利班。

sentences.en: Tonight, the Afghan army is trying to hold back the Taliban in the north's biggest city, Mazar-i-Sharif.
sentences.zh: 周六，塔利班占领了北部城市马扎里沙里夫，此前安全部队逃往邻国乌兹别克斯坦，使叛乱分子得以长驱直入。

sentences.en: On Saturday, the Taliban captured the northern city of Mazar-i-Sharif after security forces fled to neighboring Uzbekistan, allowing the insurgents to march in unopposed.
sentences.zh: 喀布尔以南的另一个阿富汗省会城市也已落入塔利班手中。

sentences.en: Another Afghan provincial capital just south of Kabul has fallen to the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 塔利班武装分子已经占领了楠格哈尔省首府贾拉拉巴德市。

sentences.en: Taliban fighters have captured the city of Jalalabad, the capital of Nangarhar province.
sentences.zh: 这是仅存的两个政府据点之一，距离首都喀布尔实际上只有几个小时的车程。

sentences.en: It was one of two remaining government strongholds, and really just a few hours drive away from the capital, Kabul.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道你是否知道这一点，但是，嗯，两个主要城市刚刚沦陷了。

sentences.en: Um, I don't know if you're aware of this, but, um, two major cities just collapsed.
sentences.zh: 看到我的国家正跪倒在地，没有人采取任何行动，整个世界只是在看着我们，这太令人心碎了。

sentences.en: And it's so devastating to see that my country is just falling on her knees, and no one is just taking any action, and just, like, the whole world just watching us out.
sentences.zh: 我根本睡不着。

sentences.en: I just can't sleep.
sentences.zh: 我在想，如果我睡着了，我会错过什么。

sentences.en: I'm like, if I sleep, I'm gonna miss something.
sentences.zh: 所以我整晚都在努力保持清醒，

sentences.en: So I'm just trying to stay awake all night,
sentences.zh: 让家人陪着我，查看朋友的情况，努力看看我能为他们做什么，能为我的家人做什么。

sentences.en: having my family with me, and just checking on my friends, and just trying to see what I can do for them, what I can do for my family.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我感到尴尬，我为这个世界感到羞耻，为那些声称自己是人权捍卫者、妇女权利捍卫者的国家感到羞耻，

sentences.en: And honestly, I feel embarrassed, and I feel ashamed on behalf of the world, on behalf of the countries that claim that they are human rights defenders, women's rights defenders,
sentences.zh: 他们来到这里是为了建立民主、言论自由、妇女权利，以及所有这些废话。

sentences.en: and they are here to, to establish democracy, and freedom of speech, women's rights, and all these bullshits.
sentences.zh: 现在他们却决定离开，让我们去死。

sentences.en: And now they have just decided to just leave, and let us die.
sentences.zh: 对世界来说，这只是一个城市的沦陷，但对我来说，这不仅仅是一个城市，因为，你知道，随着每一个城市的沦陷，都有成千上万的灵魂随之破碎。

sentences.en: To the world, it's, it's just a city that collapses, but, to me, it's not just a city, because, you know, with every city, there are, there are thousands of souls that collapse.
sentences.zh: 有成千上万、数百万的梦想随之破碎。

sentences.en: There are thousands of millions of dreams that collapse.
sentences.zh: 有成千上万的灵魂破碎了，那是我们的历史、我们的文化、我们的艺术、我们的美丽、我们的生命在破碎。

sentences.en: There are thousands of souls that collapse, they are our history, our culture, our art, our beauty, our life that collapse.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么每次我听到那个城市沦陷，我就一次又一次地崩溃。

sentences.en: And that is why, every time I hear that city collapses, I collapse again and again.
sentences.zh: 我不知道接下来会怎样，他们离喀布尔有多近，他们什么时候会接管喀布尔，

sentences.en: and I don't know what's
sentences.zh: 但我一直在告诉自己，我必须活下去，我必须坚强，

sentences.en: what is next and how they are close to Kabul and when they are going to take over Kabul
sentences.zh: 因为我需要记录所有这些事情，我需要记录一切，

sentences.en: but
sentences.zh: 我需要做点什么，因为我不希望这一切被遗忘，这太痛苦了，太令人心碎了，

sentences.en: I just keep telling myself I have to I have to stay alive I have to
sentences.zh: 这让人心碎，我感到非常悲惨，因为我感到如此无助和无力，因为我什么也做不了。

sentences.en: be strong because I need to document all these things I need to record everything
sentences.zh: 我希望我能变魔术，我希望我能做点什么，让这个国家长出翅膀，飞离这一切流血事件，拯救她的孩子们。

sentences.en: and I need to do something because I don't want this to be forgotten it's so painful it's so devastating
sentences.zh: 我不知道我该去哪里，如果我能伸出双臂去拥抱这个国家和她的人民，保护他们，那该多好，这太令人心碎了，太不公平了。

sentences.en: it's back breaking and I feel so
sentences.zh: 但我知道历史不会忘记，历史会记住每一个参与制造这场流血和混乱的人的名字和面孔。
